segments.title: A book nobody can read
segments.say: There's a six hundred year old book that nobody can read.

segments.title: 240 pages, unknown script
segments.say: Two hundred forty pages, in a script and language found nowhere else.

segments.title: Plants no one can name
segments.say: It's full of drawings, like plants no one can identify.

segments.title: Experts tried. All failed.
segments.say: For over a century, many people have tried to crack it. No one has.

segments.title: It's at Yale today
segments.say: It's the Voynich manuscript, kept at Yale's Beinecke Library since 1969.
